description: Policy for the repository boundary checks enforced by tests/conformance/contract_boundaries.rs. The file universe is the git-tracked tree; untracked and ignored files never affect a result. Rules over target code apply to tracked Rust sources under crates/, parsed with syn: identifiers and string literals are taken from the token stream with doc attributes dropped, and public positions are read from the AST. Legacy-symbol rules apply to every tracked text file outside legacy_scan_exempt_roots. An allow entry names a path prefix, a non-empty reason, and optionally the declaration (Type::member or fn name) it covers.
legacy_scan_exempt_roots_note: Roots exempt from the legacy-symbol scan only. Hash pinning is separate: docs/contracts, docs/planning/aq-cont-1, and archive are pinned by their SHA256SUMS via tests/conformance/frozen_evidence.rs; docs/adrs is a living decision queue and is not pinned.
always_excluded_note: Tracked files skipped by every scan. The policy itself names the symbols it forbids.

domain_ownership.description: Downstream ontology must not appear as identifiers in target crate code. Explanatory comments and archived evidence are exempt.

developmental_ontology.description: No queue-owned campaign, arm, benchmark, evaluation, binding-constraint, saturation, sample, or acceptance concept may exist as an identifier fragment in target crate code. Matching is case-insensitive over identifier tokens and string literals.

free_form_metadata.description: No public position in a target crate may carry a string-keyed free-form map or a JSON value, and no experiment/scheduler-hint metadata channel may exist. CausalContext stays fixed and bounded. Exceptions require an allow entry naming the declaration and a reason.
free_form_metadata.public_type_fragments_note: Matched against the whitespace-normalized type of every public field, enum-variant field of a pub enum, pub fn parameter and return type, pub trait method, pub type alias, and pub const/static. Any non-inherited visibility counts as public, including pub(crate) and pub(super): a crate-internal map is still a metadata channel between modules, so the rule is deliberately stricter than the crate's external API. Before matching, use-aliases are expanded to full paths (so a bare Value imported from serde_json matches serde_json::Value) and non-generic type aliases declared in the same file are expanded to their target (so a private `type Meta = HashMap<String, String>` does not launder a public field). Known limit: an alias declared in another file is not expanded.

allow.reason: CLI rendering sink only: the --json output of a command is serialized to stdout and never stored, matched, scheduled on, or read back by a target crate. It carries no metadata into the queue (AQ-H10). Revisit if CommandOutput ever becomes an input type.

scheduler_backchannel.description: Scheduling, budget, and platform-authority code must not read, parse, or branch on attribution references. Any exception requires an allow entry with a reason and an ADR.

metric_labels.description: High-cardinality or developmental identifiers must never be metric label names. Applies to string literals in the daemon metrics module.

archive_isolation.description: Target crates must not reference the frozen archive in any file, including Cargo manifests, build scripts, and tests.

legacy_symbols.description: Symbols slated for removal, scanned over git-tracked text files outside legacy_scan_exempt_roots. Stage 'report' fails only if the number of tracked files containing the symbol grows beyond max_files (a tight ratchet: max_files equals the baseline footprint, so any new file that names the symbol is a conscious policy bump); stage 'forbid' fails on any occurrence. A removal PR sets its symbols to 'forbid'.
